Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravinder Dudeja
ORDER % 22.12.2025 CRL.M.A. 38293/2025 exemption Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This application stands disposed of.

1. This is an application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused for the grant of interim bail on medical grounds for a period of 60 days in case FIR no. 392/2024, registered at PS Neb Sarai, under Sections 328/376/313/506/34 of IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing for the State, who seeks time to file the status report.
3. Status report be filed on or before the next date of hearing.
4. A report regarding the medical condition of the applicant may also be called from the Chief Medical Officer of Jail.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 23/12/2025 at 21:02:11 6.
In the meanwhile, nominal roll of the applicant be requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J DECEMBER 22, 2025/
